messages:
Marta G: Heads up — during last night's pressure run tenant-42's Dedicated pool dropped and a bunch of their requests were routed to hosted. That should be opt-in for Dedicated customers, right? :eyes:
Raj P: Not expected for tenants with 'isolation' enabled. We do have a fallback rule but it should respect tenant isolation. Can you paste logs?
Kevin L: Pasting terse excerpt from router logs: 
```
route_decision: tenant=tenant-42 pool=dedicated state=degraded fallback=hosted reason=pool_exhausted threshold=0.82
```
Seems fallback was allowed because the tenant was in a 'burstable' group.
Sophie R: If tenant has paid Dedicated, default should be fail-closed unless they explicitly opt into hosted spillover. Otherwise we violate isolation guarantees.
Alex O: We also don't tag requests with the fallback reason in telemetry, so Console can't show 'why' something went to hosted. Right now it's opaque: request went to hosted, but we don't surface pool_exhausted vs model_unavailable vs capacity_routing.
Amelia: Agreed. For enterprise contracts we promised no cross-tenant spillover unless customer opts in. We need an immediate circuit-breaker change plus telemetry and a Console flag.
Raj P: Propose change: new policy precedence: tenant_isolation(true) > circuit_breaker(action=fail) > fallback(hosted). Add an explicit 'allow_spillover' flag per tenant. Default = false for dedicated SKUs.
Kevin L: Example config snippet for router gate: 
```
routing {
  tenant_isolation: true
  allow_spillover: false
  circuit_breaker {
    max_inflight_per_tenant: 1200
    soft_threshold: 0.75
    hard_threshold: 0.95
    hard_action: fail
  }
}
```
Sophie R: That looks good. Also want a short-circuit metric: `tenant_spillover_rate{tenant}` and an event tag `spillover_reason`. Console needs a per-tenant timeline showing spillover events and which model variant handled the request.
Alex O: I'll add telemetry work: add attributes -> `routing_target`, `fallback_reason`, `served_model_variant`. We'll also emit an event when circuit breaker trips. Need about 3 tokenized fields, shouldn't be high cardinality.
Amelia: UX ask: in Console Rollouts view, surface a 'fallbacks' tab with counts and a toggle to 'allow hosted spillover' with an audit log link. Also a way to set per-tenant default: fail/allow/soft-burst.
Raj P: Ops question — when fallback happens to a different model variant (quantized vs full), do we consider that a degradation? Should that trigger automated rollback?
Kevin L: We already have quality-monitoring hooks but they run on eval sets. We should add a lightweight runtime signal: if fallback leads to >x% delta in response quality metrics or >y increased latency, mark rollout as degraded and flag for manual review.
Sophie R: For now let's not auto-rollback for Dedicated customers — raise flag and require human confirm. For hosted free-tier maybe auto-fallback/rollback OK.
infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-7823 to rename policy keys and add `allow_spillover` flag. Also created telemetry ticket TELE-1912 and console ticket CON-4456.
Amelia: Action items: 1) Raj update router precedence + add allow_spillover default false for Dedicated (owner: Raj) 2) Alex add fallback_reason & spillover metrics (owner: Alex) 3) Sophie update Console UX to show fallbacks + toggle + audit log (owner: Sophie) 4) Kevin draft short-lived circuit-breaker config and rollback signal thresholds (owner: Kevin).
Marta G: Thanks — please drop PRs and links here when ready. Prioritize tenant isolation defaults for enterprise SKUs first. :thumbsup:
